title: Honeyed Grape Fritters
description: A sweet dessert recipe featuring honeyed grapes deep-fried to perfection. Perfect for a quick dessert or snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grapes and honeyed. Set aside for 10 minutes to allow the grapes to release their juice.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour and water until a smooth batter forms.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the grape mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the grape fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
